source: W31 severity windows, set BEFORE the first measurement (spec/handoffs/W31-the-store.md §6). Order-of-magnitude bands from the chronologies' mortality estimates per famine-labelled year. A miss is manifested with a physical reason; windows are not moved after measuring. Boxes match the famine-frequency / yield-variance table where the region is shared.
statistic: pooled sum of famine deaths in famine-labelled years over the sum of farmers at risk in those years (persons, area-weighted), over the box's land cells

severity.name: England and northern France
severity.citation: 1315–17 ~10–15 % over three years (Jordan 1996, Kershaw 1973); 1438–39 a few per cent (Hatcher); 1596–98 2–3 % in the north (Appleby 1978); other labelled failures under 1 %

severity.name: The Deccan interior
severity.citation: 1876–78: 5.5–8M of ~58M in the affected presidencies over two years (Maharatna 1996); 1896–97 and 1899–1900 lower

severity.name: The North China Plain
severity.citation: 1876–79: 9–13M of ~108M over three years (Edgerton-Tarpley 2008); 1920–21 a fraction of that

severity.name: The Sahel
severity.citation: 1913–14 severe locally; 1968–74 ~0.5–1 % of the region; 1983–85 ~1 % (Watts 1983, Cissoko 1968)

run.note: Share of famine deaths that fall in a year whose predecessor at the same cell also fell short (harvest < need). Measured over years 2–7 of a solve firing (years with a predecessor); solve-only.
